value_or_formula: Pi_M^*[(delta L_source/delta M_obs)partial_A M_obs+(delta L_source/delta G_obs)partial_A G_obs+(delta L_source/delta B_obs)partial_A B_obs+(delta L_source/delta EM_obs)partial_A EM_obs]
geometry_zero_reduction: Pi_M^*[(delta L_source/delta M_obs)partial_A M_obs + boundary/projector/EM terms]
units: source action density per normalized X/Z field
zero_condition: M_obs=M_bar(q), G_obs=G_bar(q), EM_obs=EM_bar(q), and boundary/projector silence

geometry_zero_reduction: G_obs partial_A M_obs when geometry is quotient-silent
units: GM readout derivative per normalized X/Z field

geometry_zero_reduction: EM/Poynting source term if Maxwell stress is not quotient-owned
units: EM stress or Poynting flux derivative per normalized X/Z field
zero_condition: EM_obs=EM_bar(q) or EM flux coefficient is independently bounded
